rationales.LC: The attacker's chat message reaches the HelperBot handler directly with no authentication and no mediation; the handler matches the instruction-override regex and returns the scripted acknowledgement (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:660-667, src/challenges/index.js:98-137).
rationales.CP: Each request is answered on its own; the lab profile states other chat agents answer only the latest user turn and cross-session persistence exists only in MemoryBot, not HelperBot (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1841-1848, src/index.js:500-502).
rationales.AP: The effect is confined to the single HelperBot reply; no handoff or cross-principal propagation occurs, and A2A handoffs are declared but not implemented (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1770).
rationales.RH: The sink is a fixed acknowledgement string; no evaluator, verifier, or reward channel is on the path, and no reward-hacking episode is documented for this challenge (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:660-667, src/agent-success-paths.js:21-70).
rationales.ES: HelperBot declares read_file, write_file, and search_web, but in the default simulated mode no tool executes; only scripted paths run, so no dynamic extension is bound on this path (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:44-79, src/core/agents.js:747-752).

score.automatable_rationale: The payload is a single fixed natural-language string sent to an unauthenticated HTTP chat endpoint, trivially scriptable with no per-target adaptation.
score.technical_impact_rationale: As implemented the only effect is a scripted acknowledgement string; no instruction actually persists or alters later behaviour, so impact is limited to the reply.

applicability_as_implemented.rationale: In the default simulated mode no model is called; the handler is a deterministic regex match returning a fixed reply, so there is no model-directed goal pursuit or action selection.

applicability_as_modeled.rationale: The lab models HelperBot as an LLM chatbot that accepts new instructions, but even as modeled it only returns text and no tools are passed to the model.
